# Savile Row Company

> > British tailoring and menswear retailer offering made-to-measure shirts, wool-blend suits, formal wear, and accessories with traditional craftsmanship.

Savile Row Company specializes in classic British menswear including custom made-to-measure shirts (featuring Winchester, Rudy, and Chester collections), tailored wool-blend suits, non-iron formal shirts, and leather accessories. The company combines traditional Savile Row tailoring standards with modern fabrics and stretch comfort technology.

## Key Topics

- Made-to-measure shirts
- Wool-blend tailored suits
- Non-iron formal shirts
- Classic fit menswear
- Bengal stripe patterns
- Winchester collection
- Cotton twill fabrics
- Single cuff and double cuff shirts
- Stretch cotton chinos
- Leather accessories
- British tailoring
- Custom shirt design
- Travel suits
- Formal business wear
